title: Learning to Look Beyond Screens: Transferable Visual Observation from GUI Grounding
abstract: arXiv:2610.37093v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Visual perception is evolving from passive recognition toward active, task-oriented observation. We investigate GUI grounding as a scalable source of spatial supervision for learning observation behaviors that transfer beyond interfaces. We introduce LBS (Look Beyond Screens), a vision-language model trained through supervised initialization on teacher-generated GUI grounding trajectories, followed by reinforcement learning for multi-turn crop-and-inspect decisions. Under fixed inference settings, LBS models based on Qwen3.5-35B-A3B and Qwen3.8-27B consistently improve over their corresponding baselines. Gains beyond supervised fine-tuning transfer to PerceptionBench for both backbones and to HR-Bench and ChartQAPro for Qwen3.5-35B-A3B, supporting observation strategies that generalize beyond GUI-specific imitation. Further analysis suggests complementary roles for the two stages: SFT establishes visual inspection primitives, while RL

translated_title: 学会超越屏幕观察：源自GUI定位的可迁移视觉观察
translated_abstract: 视觉感知正在从被动识别向主动的、面向任务的观察演进。我们研究将GUI（图形用户界面）定位作为可扩展的空间监督来源，用于学习能够迁移到界面之外场景的观察行为。我们提出了LBS（Look Beyond Screens，超越屏幕观察），这是一个视觉-语言模型，首先通过在教师生成的GUI定位轨迹上进行监督初始化训练，随后通过强化学习进行多轮裁剪与检查决策。在固定推理设置下，基于Qwen3.5-35B-A3B和Qwen3.8-27B的LBS模型始终优于其对应的基线模型。超越监督微调的性能提升在两个骨干模型上均可迁移至PerceptionBench，并在Qwen3.5-35B-A3B上可迁移至HR-Bench和ChartQAPro，这支持了观察策略能够超越GUI特定模仿而实现泛化。进一步分析表明两个阶段具有互补作用：SFT建立视觉检查的基本能力，而RL（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出LBS模型，将GUI定位作为可扩展的空间监督来源，通过监督微调建立视觉检查基础能力、再通过强化学习实现多轮裁剪与检查决策，训练出可从屏幕界面泛化到通用视觉感知基准的主动观察能力。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces LBS, a vision-language model that leverages GUI grounding as a scalable source of spatial supervision—using supervised fine-tuning to establish visual inspection primitives and reinforcement learning for multi-turn crop-and-inspect decisions—yielding active observation strategies that generalize beyond screen interfaces to general visual perception benchmarks.
